name: noreclient-web
description: Nore Client website and API (Cloudflare Workers)

scripts.build:standalone: mkdir -p dist && cp public/app.js dist/app.js.txt && cp public/api.js dist/api.js.txt && cp public/mc/status.js dist/mc-status.js.txt && esbuild src/standalone.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --loader:.html=text --loader:.css=text --loader:.txt=text --external:cloudflare:* --minify --outfile=dist/site.mjs
